title: lever__interview_enhanced duplicates rows when an interview has multiple deleted feedback forms
fix: Join interview_feedback to the live (not deleted) feedback forms first, then left join interview to that, so a link to a deleted form adds no row; restore the uniqueness test removed in 7829497; add seed rows that link across tables (two deleted forms on one interview, one live and one deleted form on another, and the two interviews pointed at opportunities that exist in the seeds, without which the mart's inner join drops them).

steps.name: bug reproduced: main's models, with the new seed rows, fail the restored uniqueness test
steps.run: git apply {patch} && git checkout HEAD -- models/intermediate/int_lever__interview_feedback.sql && cd integration_tests && dbt deps && dbt seed && dbt build --select +lever__interview_enhanced

steps.name: fixed: with the fix, the same build and tests pass
steps.run: git apply {patch} && cd integration_tests && dbt deps && dbt seed && dbt build --select +lever__interview_enhanced

steps.name: found without the new seed rows: fixwitness on the model change alone, with main's own seeds (whose keys do not link across tables)
steps.run: git apply {patch} && git checkout HEAD -- integration_tests models/lever.yml && python -m fixwitness check --base HEAD --no-attacks --out-dir {out}/fw_models

steps.name: the change as submitted: fixwitness on the whole patch (model, test and seed rows)
steps.run: git apply {patch} && python -m fixwitness check --base HEAD --no-attacks --out-dir {out}/fw_patch
